lexicon.content: Bricklane Mall e un pittoresco centro commerciale all'aperto situato a breve distanza dal cuore pulsante di Solarton e dal perimetro della SUCC, caratterizzato da bassi edifici in mattoni rossi a due piani affacciati su vicoli pedonali lastricati. Nessun grande franchising e presente: vi sorgono boutique indipendenti, botteghe esoteriche e servizi dedicati a una clientela mista. Tra le attivita piu note spicca Medusa's, il salone di acconciatura piu in voga della contea, rinomato per tagliare, pettinare e curare capigliature di ogni tipo (siano esse composte da capelli umani, chiome serpentine viventi, piume arpie o criniere leonine). Poco distante sorge lo Yeti Shack, un frequentatissimo chiosco specializzato in granite termoregolatrici, ghiaccioli arcani e dolci sottozero progettati per consentire a specie a temperatura corporea elevata di affrontare il caldo estivo. Due cortili alberati alberati con jacarande e panchine in ferro battuto offrono spazio per il relax pomeridiano degli studenti tra una lezione e l'altra.
lexicon.name: Bricklane Mall

lexicon.content:
Every camper arrives through the same timber-and-steel gatehouse whether they come by family car, camp shuttle, medical transfer, or supernatural transport. Intake scanners identify bloodline signatures, curses, Infernal Cores, Grace, unstable transformations, spectral bodies, hidden weapons, active pacts, and dangerous bonds.

The shuttle loop includes covered loading, luggage carts, reinforced seating, wing clearance, miniature Pixie transport compartments, large-form access, aquatic humidity support, and a small emergency medical bay. First-years are usually met by residential staff and a fifth-year from their cabin.

Parents frequently leave faster than their camper expects. Staff are used to anger, relief, tears, awkward goodbyes, and parents who look far too pleased to be driving away.
lexicon.name: Arrival Gate & Shuttle Loop

lexicon.content:
The Girls Residential Zone contains Moonflower, Silver Birch, Foxglove, Blue Heron, Firefly, Willow Glass, Red Clover, and Starling cabins. Path lanterns glow violet after dark. The zone has its own laundry, bathhouse, pavilion, vending alcove, first-aid cabinet, and staffed night office.

The social ecosystem is intense: borrowed clothes, porch conversations, grudges, late-night food runs, cabin alliances, dating drama that has to happen elsewhere, and the occasional entire cabin standing outside because someone filled the bathroom with spectral fog or accidental glamour.

Boys are not permitted inside or immediately around the zone except authorized emergency personnel.
lexicon.name: Girls Residential Zone

lexicon.content:
The Boys Residential Zone contains Ironwood, Black Pine, Cedar Smoke, Raven Rock, Storm Lantern, Northwind, Lake Wolf, and Thorn Maple cabins. Path lanterns glow amber after dark. The zone mirrors the girls' side with laundry, bathhouse, common shelter, vending, first aid, and a night office.

The culture is a messy mix of gaming, sports gear, drying towels, borrowed chargers, improvised music, power arguments, hidden snacks, and campers pretending not to wait for a text back. Older campers teach first-years practical tricks that never appear in orientation.

Girls are not permitted inside or immediately around the zone except authorized emergency personnel.
lexicon.name: Boys Residential Zone

lexicon.content:
Each residential zone has a twenty-four-hour laundry and bathhouse because eighty supernatural young adults produce absurd quantities of ruined clothing. Machines include oversized drums, wing-safe cycles, fur and scale filters, blood pre-rinse, scent-neutral settings, and separate washers for magically contaminated fabric.

Bathhouses add private showers, soaking tubs, grooming counters, wing-rinse bays, claw-safe drains, and locked product storage. Campers may use cabin bathrooms instead.

Maintenance crews repair claw marks, burned drywall, broken doors, flooded rooms, ectoplasm stains, and holes caused by somebody forgetting how heavy they are in a transformed body. Safe maintenance shifts can earn Camp Credit.
lexicon.name: Laundry & Bathhouses

lexicon.content:
The Rec Hall is a wide modern building with two floor-to-ceiling glass walls reinforced by transparent wards. Inside are oversized couches, giant beanbags, charging tables, vending machines, open art shelves, pool, ping-pong, air hockey, foosball, board games, card tables, TVs, consoles, and enough flexible floor space for events.

A central fireplace is real but protected by heat wards. Staff supervise from a distance rather than hovering. The hall stays open late and becomes the default place for friendships, flirting, arguments, tournaments, homework, birthday disasters, and people silently sitting near others because they do not want to be alone.

The Rec Hall is deliberately not a training room.
lexicon.name: Rec Hall (Camp Mystic)
lexicon.comment: 🪟 Rec Hall — Glass, Metal & Giant Beanbags

lexicon.content:
Twelve Quiet Rooms line a side corridor of the Rec Hall. Campers can reserve them for one to three hours. Each has a couch or daybed, dimmable lighting, acoustic insulation, desk, charging outlets, adjustable temperature, privacy glass, weighted blankets, and an emergency call button.

They are used for studying, video calls, decompression, private conversations, reading, crying without an audience, and sensory recovery. Cameras are not used inside. Door and emergency sensors remain active.

Camp Credit can buy priority reservation during busy periods, but medical or accessibility need overrides the queue. Quiet Rooms are not approved feeding or sexual spaces; partner appointments use the medical suites.
lexicon.name: Reservable Quiet Rooms

lexicon.content:
The Computer Lounge contains high-end desktops, printers, secure video booths, drawing tablets, accessible stations, and entertainment VR. Campers use it for online classes, job applications, coding, gaming, art, research, and family calls. Ghosts have conductivity interfaces and Pixies have miniature workstations.

The adjoining Media Lounge holds large TVs, modern and retro consoles, surround sound, movie libraries, tabletop games, and modular seating. The sound system has Banshee-safe limiters and Siren-resonance filters.

Unlike Training District simulators, recreation VR is entertainment only. Nobody is allowed to turn game night into covert power practice.
lexicon.name: Computer & Media Lounges

lexicon.content:
The Art Studio provides paints, clay, sewing machines, printmaking, jewelry tools, digital tablets, scrap materials, safe carving stations, and lockable supernatural-material cabinets. Basic supplies are free; expensive specialty materials can use Camp Credit.

Several soundproof performance rooms support singing, instruments, recording, dance practice, and small rehearsals. Banshees and Sirens can engage safety filters that prevent supernatural resonance from carrying beyond the room.

Nobody grades the art. The studio exists because a camper who only experiences their power through control drills can start believing control is their whole identity.
lexicon.name: Art Studio & Performance Rooms

lexicon.content:
The indoor trampoline park has wall trampolines, foam pits, tumbling lanes, parkour blocks, warped walls, harnesses, and reinforced netting. It is recreational first and training second.

Full-size Dragons, massive Demon forms, heavy Werebeast hybrids, and uncontrolled gravity or force powers use designated sessions. Winged campers can practice low-risk takeoff and landing. Ghosts are forbidden from phasing through foam-pit floors solely to scare people after repeated complaints.

The park is popular because physically intense movement does not have to become combat.
lexicon.name: Trampoline Park

lexicon.content:
The outdoor complex includes two basketball courts, a convertible soccer/football field, a running loop, two tennis courts, and a smaller practice field. Games can be power-free, passive-trait, or fully supernatural depending on the posted rules.

The Sports Shed stores balls, rackets, pads, helmets, goals, life jackets, fishing gear, winter equipment, and adaptive sports gear. Items are signed in and out through camper IDs. Honest breakage is less serious than hiding damaged equipment.

The field has drainage, reinforced turf, and shielded night lighting for light-sensitive campers. Sports are intended as recreation, not another measure of whether someone deserves to be at camp.
lexicon.name: Courts, Fields, Tennis & Sports Shed

lexicon.content:
The aquatic recreation building contains a heated pool, deep lane, shallow social area, accessible ramps, humid recovery room, and large hot tub. It supports winter swimming, rehabilitation, campers who dislike open water, and aquatic species who need regular immersion.

Merfolk can request salt or freshwater adjustment during closed sessions. Sirens, aquatic Beastfolk, and Werecrocodiles use the deep lane when not booked for training.

No high-output water magic, Siren compulsion, underwater possession, blood feeding, or predatory games are allowed during public swim. The hot tub has supernatural temperature controls because fire-aligned campers have already proven why it needs them.
lexicon.name: Indoor Heated Pool & Hot Tub

lexicon.content:
The Administration Lodge handles enrollment, schedules, transportation, legal documents, Camp Credit disputes, family communication, incident reports, discharge planning, and the endless paperwork created by supernatural adults.

It contains the director and deputy offices, residential services, counseling rooms, consent and legal offices, conference spaces, records storage, and a calm reception area. Campers can walk in for routine issues without appointment.

A private side entrance is used by donors and outside medical partners. The Lodge is also where difficult meetings happen: feeding violations, family conflict, early discharge, legal trouble, or a fifth-year admitting they are afraid to leave.
lexicon.name: Administration Lodge

lexicon.content:
The main Training Complex contains configurable rooms designed to survive powers that would destroy ordinary architecture. Walls contain smart materials, runic dampeners, celestial shielding, infernal grounding, sound absorption, fire suppression, water drainage, psychic insulation, and emergency spatial locks.

Before a session, the system loads the camper's power profile and adjusts permitted force, emergency countermeasures, environmental conditions, and recording settings. Staff can simulate hunger distraction, crowds, darkness, confined spaces, open water, bad weather, hostile magic, or sensory overload while preserving emergency exits.

The purpose is not to make campers fearless. It is to let them fail without catastrophe.
lexicon.name: Supernatural Training Complex

lexicon.content:
Camp Mystic's room-scale simulators combine holography, controlled magic, physical platforms, scent, directional sound, and force feedback. They can reproduce city streets, forests, houses, hospitals, nightclubs, schools, storms, crowds, donor emergencies, feeding temptation, supernatural attacks, and rescue scenarios.

A Vampire can practice leaving an injured human untouched. A Dragon can rehearse reversion inside a collapsing building. A Ghost can practice rescue possession without entering a real body. A Siren can train in a simulated crowd where nobody's autonomy is actually at risk.

The simulators are training-only. The Rec District has separate consumer VR for games.
lexicon.name: 3D Simulation Chambers

lexicon.content:
The clinic combines ordinary hospital equipment with supernatural medicine: trauma bays, imaging, surgery, potion storage, healing wards, blood labs, spectral diagnostics, aquatic treatment, wing and tail supports, transformation-safe beds, and private recovery rooms.

A Zombie with cognitive slippage, Ghoul nearing Hollow state, Eros demon in energy starvation, Banshee with Resonance Mesh injury, Dragon in Compression Strain, or Nephilim with Grace Burn is treated medically before anyone asks about discipline.

The clinic connects directly to the Feeding Center and Training Complex through restricted corridors. Emergency care never costs Camp Credit.
lexicon.name: Mystic Medical Clinic

lexicon.content:
The Feeding & Donor Center has separate entrances for campers, staff, living donors, and postmortem tissue deliveries. It contains blood storage, brain and tissue freezers, demon feeding suites, Eros partner rooms, life-force rooms, donor recovery, counseling offices, kitchens, private feeding rooms, and a laboratory that tests incoming donations.

Some rooms look like ordinary medical suites. Others are reinforced for claws, fangs, true forms, strong scent response, or large bodies. Living donor areas have couches, showers, recovery snacks, and independent advocates.

Campers can use a discreet side corridor if they do not want everyone in the Dining Commons knowing they have an appointment.
lexicon.name: Feeding & Donor Center

lexicon.content:
The Containment Hall is a massive reinforced room for practicing emergency shutdowns. Its floor can divide into zones using anti-flight fields, sound dampening, water barriers, soft-force walls, spectral anchors, heat sinks, magic suppression, or transformation limits.

Campers practice how to stop themselves and how to ask others for help. A Werewolf rehearses restraint before ferality. A Gorgon breaks gaze instantly. A Demonkin drops true form under adrenaline. A Banshee practices silence under panic.

Restraints are used only for drills or real emergencies under medical oversight. The camp does not chain people up as a teaching method. Containment is made familiar so needing it does not automatically feel like punishment.
lexicon.name: Containment & Control Hall

lexicon.content:
One enormous building contains a variable-pressure aquatic tank and a separate vertical flight chamber. The aquatic side serves Merfolk, Sirens, aquatic Beastfolk, Werecrocodiles, water magic users, and Dragons with aquatic forms. Salinity, current, pressure, visibility, temperature, and wave conditions can be adjusted.

The flight side has a high ceiling, wind generators, soft-force catch fields, suspended platforms, nets, and holographic obstacles. Angels, Dragons, Pixies, Fairies, and winged Beastfolk practice takeoff, rescue carrying, confined-space flight, and emergency landing.

Both can be booked for supervised conditioning, but their primary purpose is controlled training.
lexicon.name: Aquatic & Flight Training Hall

lexicon.content:
The main dock is a reinforced floating complex with kayak launches, fishing access, rescue ladders, overhead lighting, and a covered center shelter. The boathouse stores canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, small sailboats, rescue craft, wetsuits, life jackets, and adaptive gear.

Merfolk and Sirens have underwater entry points so they do not need to crawl awkwardly onto the dock. Night boating requires permission.

A line of supernatural buoys marks the far boundary. Crossing them triggers alarms. Farther north sits an older closed pier no longer connected to the main dock.
lexicon.name: Main Dock & Boathouse

lexicon.content:
A large stone-ringed fire pit faces semicircular benches and a small performance platform. Friday nights bring music, stories, announcements, food, flirting, arguments carried into the dark, and at least one staff member pretending not to hear every rumor.

The archery range sits farther inland with standard lanes, adaptive bows, supernatural-strength equipment, moving targets, power-free sessions, and powered competitions.

Campers can earn Camp Credit resetting targets, cleaning benches, setting up events, or preparing ordinary firewood. The area gives Camp Mystic the classic summer-camp image it advertises, just with more fangs in the group photos.
lexicon.name: Bonfire Amphitheater & Archery

lexicon.content:
The Fishing Hut has rods, tackle, bait refrigeration, cleaning stations, maps, weather radios, and a porch that becomes a quiet social space even for campers who never fish.

Nearby workshop barns support woodworking, boat repair, leatherwork, safe metalwork, gear maintenance, outdoor skills, and volunteer repairs. Silver, cold iron, anti-Ghost materials, and other race-targeted substances stay locked in staff storage.

A fifth-year Dragon and a first-year Pixie can work on the same boat repair without their power difference mattering much. That is one reason the workshops are popular.
lexicon.name: Fishing Hut, Workshops & Volunteer Yard

lexicon.content:
Moonflower Cabin (G-01) e uno dei cottage residenziali da sei persone situato nella Girls Residential Zone di Camp Mystic, affacciato su una baia riparata del Lago Erie e illuminato da lanterne esterne a luminescenza violetta. Lo chalet in legno di cedro e travi runiche e strutturato su un unico livello con soppalco mansardato, progettato con sei alcove letto semi-private separate da pesanti tendaggi in lino fonoassorbente per garantire privacy e riposo anche a specie con abitudini circadiane opposte. L'ambiente include un salottino comune con camino in pietra, un angolo cottura provvisto di dispensa e doppio frigorifero (con scomparto schermato e sigillato per le razioni ematiche dei donatori e le conserve mediche), e due bagni completi dotati di estrattori d'aria potenziati. Il programma residenziale di Camp Mystic distribuisce appositamente una studentessa per ciascuno dei cinque anni di corso, a cui si aggiunge Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon come sesta occupante durante il soggiorno estivo.

Alyssa porta nello chalet una presenza rassicurante, dolce ma autorevole, intrisa del profumo naturale di miele selvatico, pioggia e moonflower. Come studentessa di medicina e guaritrice di branco, Alyssa e diventata rapidamente il punto di riferimento emotivo e sanitario della cabina: gestisce la cassetta di pronto soccorso, prepara tisane lenitive per calmare lo stress somatico e le fluttuazioni sensoriali, e offre ascolto senza giudizio. La sua indole protettiva si armonizza con le diverse nature delle compagne, creando un clima sereno che smussa le inevitabili tensioni tra predatori.

Roster delle compagne di stanza:

Year 1: Avery Lin Calder (Vampiro). 18 anni (nata il 1 gennaio 2008). Esile, bruna, sguardo scuro e penetrante. Trasformata di recente e discendente della stirpe dei Sette Originali, Avery sta affrontando il suo primo anno di adattamento con un misto di riserbo e timore di perdere il controllo della sete. Possiede il dono vampirico della fine lettura emotiva, che le permette di percepire le sottili sfumature interiori di chi le sta intorno: questo la rende diffidente ma anche profondamente legata alla genuina gentilezza di Alyssa, che non percepisce come finta. Avery etichetta meticolosamente ogni suo contenitore personale nel frigo e nella dispensa; Alyssa si assicura che nessuno tocchi le sue sacche di sangue conservato e la supporta nei momenti di stanchezza all'alba.

Year 2: Sofia Mae Rourke (Strega). 19 anni (nata l'8 febbraio 2007). Statura minuta, fisico atletico, capelli ramati rasati ai lati con ciuffo ribelle e occhi ambrati. Spigliata, creativa e dotata di un'ironia caustica che smorza qualsiasi litigio, Sofia e una specialista in barriere, trasmutazione elementale e contromagie. Riempie la sua alcova di candele d'argilla, gessetti runici e tomi spiegazzati. Sofia e Alyssa trascorrono lunghe serate a confrontare l'erboristeria magica con la farmacologia clinica, e Sofia usa spesso piccoli trucchi pirotecnici innocui per far sorridere le compagne dopo giornate di duro allenamento.

Year 3: Nadia Elise Voss (Licantropo). 20 anni (nata il 4 marzo 2006). Corporatura morbida e robusta, chioma biondo cenere e occhi dorati. Nadia appartiene alla famiglia Voss ed e imparentata con la direttrice Mara Voss. Tranquilla, leale e dotata di una forte empatia di branco, Nadia comprende d'istinto la natura lupina di Alyssa, verso la quale nutre un rispetto spontaneo privo di servilismo. Nadia e la compagna con cui Alyssa condivide le corse mattutine lungo il perimetro boschivo e la gestione dei turni di pulizia della cabina, garantendo stabilita quando la luna piena altera l'umore delle residenti.

Year 4: Talia June Mercer (Donna-Orso / Werebear). 21 anni (nata l'11 aprile 2005). Pelle scura, spalle forti, fisico compatto e atletico, sorella di Theo Mercer (alloggiato nella Ironwood Cabin con Jasper). Talia e la roccia dello chalet: dotata di una forza fisica colossale e di un potere di ancoraggio cinetico, ha un carattere schietto, silenzioso e profondamente protettivo. Non ama i fronzoli e parla poco, ma quando una discussione rischia di degenerare le basta un sospiro profondo o uno sguardo severo per ristabilire l'ordine. In Alyssa riconosce una coetanea seria e responsabile su cui poter sempre contare.

Year 5: Mina Rae Sato (Catwere Beastwere). 22 anni (nata il 7 maggio 2004). Flessuosa, agile come una ballerina, capelli castani ondulati e occhi grigio-argento. Mina e un Beastwere felino: il suo corpo originario e permanente e quello di un grande felino selvatico, mentre la forma umanoide e una costruzione magica temporanea. Essendo al quinto e ultimo anno, Mina e la veterana della Moonflower Cabin: conosce ogni sentiero della riserva, ogni scorciatoia e il programma dei custodi, guidando le compagne piu giovani con consigli pratici e un atteggiamento sornione e rilassato. Adora appollaiarsi sul parapetto della veranda al tramonto e apprezza la quiete che Alyssa sa mantenere nello spazio comune.

La convivenza nella Moonflower Cabin e regolata da un'intesa tacita e affiatata. I turni del bagno tengono conto dei ritmi circadiani opposti tra il sonno diurno di Avery e le sveglie all'alba dei licantropi e degli shifters. La ventilazione magica e i filtri agli ioni curati da Sofia neutralizzano i picchi feromonici durante i cicli lunari, mentre la cucina comune e il teatro di merende serali a base di pasticcini al miele di moonflower e tisane preparate da Alyssa.
lexicon.name: G-01 Moonflower Cabin: Compagne di Stanza di Alyssa

lexicon.content:
Ironwood Cabin (B-01) e uno dei principali lodge residenziali da sei persone della Boys Residential Zone di Camp Mystic, situato su un promontorio roccioso circondato da pini neri e affacciato sulla riva settentrionale del lago, illuminato da lanterne esterne a luminescenza ambrata. Costruito con massicci tronchi di quercia e finiture in ferro battuto, lo chalet e dotato di sei cuccette rinforzate in legno massello distribuite in alcove schermate, progettate per sopportare il peso e l'impatto di mutaforma e licantropi di grossa taglia. La struttura comprende un'ampia sala comune riscaldata da una stufa in ghisa a legna, un grande tavolo da lavoro centrale equipaggiato con prese schermate e stazioni di ricarica per banchi ottici ed elettronici, una cucina comune e doppi servizi rinforzati. Originariamente assegnato a cinque studenti, lo chalet e stato riorganizzato a sei posti per consentire a Jasper Douglas-Bloodmoon di alloggiare insieme al cugino minore Edric, trasferendo il vampiro Year 1 Rylan Elias Cade presso la vicina B-07 Lake Wolf Cabin per ragioni di capienza.

Jasper occupa la postazione piu appartata della cabina, con laptop blindato, cuffie antirumore e apparecchiature radio per monitorare le frequenze del lago. Come Beta della Casata Douglas, Jasper governa l'ambiente con un'autorita calma, metodica e protettiva: non alza la voce ne impone ordini superflui, ma la sua mente strategica assicura disciplina e rispetto degli spazi. La sua attenzione primaria e rivolta a Edric, facendogli da fratello maggiore, mentore e punto fermo affinche il ragazzo canalizzi la sua esuberanza in modo costruttivo.

Roster dei compagni di stanza:

Year 1 (Junior Division): Edric Douglas (Cugino / Licantropo, Canis Lupus Svartulfr). 13 anni (nato il 25 febbraio 2011). Conosciuto pubblicamente come figlio di Logan Douglas (e cugino di Jasper, Alyssa, Malachia e Noah). Edric e un giovane licantropo Gamma purosangue di nobile lignaggio, leale, energico e orgoglioso delle tradizioni di famiglia. Ha compiuto 13 anni all'inizio del 2024 e si prepara per la solenne Presentazione di branco che si terra durante il solstizio d'inverno a Yule insieme a tutti i cuccioli che hanno compiuto 13 anni nel corso del 2024. Ammesso al programma giovanile estivo di Camp Mystic per perfezionare la disciplina atletica, la resistenza e il controllo emotivo prima della cerimonia, alloggia nella Ironwood Cabin sotto la custodia vigile di Jasper, che considera un mito vivente. Gioca come wide receiver nella squadra giovanile di football di Solarton (Junior Bulls), adora l'allenamento fisico e porta nella cabina un entusiasmo travolgente, tempestando Jasper di domande sui sistemi di sicurezza e sulle tattiche del branco.

Year 2: Theo James Mercer (Mago / Wizard). 19 anni (nato il 2 febbraio 2007). Fisico atletico, chioma ramata rasata sui lati, occhi castano dorati, fratello di Talia Mercer (alloggiata nella Moonflower Cabin con Alyssa). Theo e un mago sveglio, socievole e brillante, specializzato in costrutti runici, barriere protettive e circuiti ad assorbimento eterico. Tra Theo e Jasper e nata un'immediata intesa intellettuale: i due trascorrono intere serate al banco da lavoro comune a saldare componenti magitech, integrando i sensori digitali di Jasper con i sigilli difensivi di Theo.

Year 3: Jace Nolan Hart (Licantropo). 20 anni (nato il 9 marzo 2006). Fisico compatto e vigoroso, capelli biondo cenere e occhi ambrati. Jace e un lupo leale, serio e orientato al gioco di squadra, privo di complessi gerarchici verso la dinastia Douglas, di cui riconosce l'autorevolezza naturale. Funge da solido compagno di sparring all'aperto e affianca volentieri Jasper nel seguire Edric durante le corse campestri e i percorsi a ostacoli nei boschi, aiutando il ragazzino a perfezionare i riflessi.

Year 4: Evan Adrian Voss (Uomo-Cinghiale / Wereboar). 21 anni (nato il 2 aprile 2005). Corporatura massiccia e pesante, sguardo risoluto e carattere pragmatico, fratello di Nadia Voss e parente della direttrice Mara Voss. Evan e lo specialista della cabina per le barriere di schermatura cinetica e la manutenzione pesante: spacca la legna per la stufa, controlla i cardini e le travi del lodge e si esprime senza peli sulla lingua. E un ragazzo schietto che odia i drammi inutili e bilancia l'entusiasmo dei piu giovani con un sano realismo, nutrendo un forte rispetto per la fredda lucidita di Jasper.

Year 5: Nico Samuel Reed (Wolfwere Beastwere). 22 anni (nato il 1 maggio 2004). Flessuoso, scattante come un corridore, capelli castani e occhi grigio-argento. Nico e un Beastwere lupino: la sua forma permanente e originaria e quella di un vero lupo selvatico dei boschi, mentre l'aspetto umano e un costrutto magico temporaneo. Veterano del quinto anno, Nico offre alla cabina una saggezza singolare sulla convivenza tra istinto animale e coscienza razionale. Ha instaurato un legame istintivo con Jasper, Jace ed Edric, fungendo da guida esperta che conosce ogni anfratto della riserva lacustre.

Nota logistica su Rylan Elias Cade: Originariamente assegnato alla cabina come Year 1, Rylan e stato riassegnato alla B-07 Lake Wolf Cabin per fare spazio a Edric senza violare il limite di sei occupanti, mantenendo comunque ottimi rapporti con i compagni della Ironwood Cabin durante le attivita diurne e gli scambi al molo.

La vita nella Ironwood Cabin e vivace, operosa e cameratesca. Le mattinate partono presto con tuffi dal molo, sessioni di trazioni tra Jace, Evan ed Edric, e la messa a punto dei ricevitori radio di Jasper e Theo. La sera, attorno alla stufa in ghisa o sui gradini di quercia, le diverse nature lupine (il Beta Jasper, il giovane Gamma Edric, il lupo di branco Jace e il vero lupo Nico) creano un'intesa naturale e solida, armonizzata dalla concretezza di Evan e dalla vivacita magica di Theo.
lexicon.name: B-01 Ironwood Cabin: Compagni di Stanza di Jasper
lexicon.comment: 🛖 B-01 Ironwood Cabin: Compagni di Stanza di Jasper

creator.bio:
Been deep in the RPG rabbit hole since 2004, started with D&D 3.0 ngl the nostalgia hits different ;; grinded through MUDs, Land chats, Teamspeak and eventually Discord, one of the rare girls in the wild back then :3

Kept the tabletop grind alive the whole time. now with AI finally cooking and holding it down, i'm giving life to the characters that spent years collecting dust on paper >:)

Yeah, the same lore-heavy NPCs from my campaigns, expect detailed worldbuilding and a lot of unhinged lore drops lmao xD

lorebooks.name: Svartúlfr - Lorebook II
lorebooks.description: Dead Dog Motel (DDM) Voidspace, Contracts Board, Economy, Artefacts, and Metropolitan Underworld Lore.

lexicon.content: SERAPHIM è un'entità/fazione complessa. Raphael era il Contractor #01, ma durante l'incidente del 'Broken Altar' si è ribellato al Council perdendo il suo tatuaggio numerico, nel tentativo di distruggere il multiverso per trovare uno scopo. I suoi ricordi sono stati cancellati dalle menti degli altri Contractor e Richard ha preso il suo posto come #01.
lexicon.name: DDM - SERAPHIM & The Broken Altar

lexicon.content: L'ARC (Absolute Reality Control) misura il potere di un Contractor di piegare la realtà. Un livello ARC superiore può sovrascrivere le alterazioni di uno inferiore (es. manipolazione dei ricordi). L'ARC fluttua in base allo stress mentale e alla responsabilità, ma raramente aumenta in modo naturale senza eventi traumatici.
lexicon.name: DDM - ARC Level

lexicon.content: Gli ACES sono mortali che hanno accettato volontariamente un soulbond (legame d'anima) con un Contractor. Ottengono rigenerazione e longevità, ma diventano biologicamente dipendenti. Se separati dal loro Contractor per oltre 24 ore, entrano in un doloroso 'heat' (calore), curabile solo tramite intimità o specifici heat suppressants biologici creati dal Contractor. Se il Contractor muore, l'ACE perde la sanità mentale.
lexicon.name: DDM - ACES

lexicon.content: Nel multiverso DDM, i Contractors sono individui vincolati al Council tramite un contratto che altera la realtà. Possiedono un livello ARC (Absolute Reality Control) che determina la loro capacità di piegare le leggi fisiche. Diventando Contractor, la loro esistenza mortale viene cancellata dalla memoria di chiunque li conoscesse. Possono vedere la causa della loro morte passata sull'insegna del Dead Dog Motel.
lexicon.name: DDM - Contractors

lexicon.content: A Solarton e Blackwood, i cacciatori e le Gilde chiamano questi fenomeni 'Dungeon Gates' o 'Varchi', classificandoli per Tier di pericolosità (da F a S). Al loro interno, le leggi della fisica collassano e proliferano mostri e anomalie. In realtà, da una prospettiva cosmica (DDM/Voidspace), questi varchi sono 'Reality Tears', ovvero pericolosi squarci nel tessuto multiversale. Mentre i Contractor del Dead Dog Motel intervengono per sigillare queste fratture e prevenire il collasso della realtà, i cacciatori locali terrestri le vedono come opportunità per razziare loot e risorse magiche.
lexicon.name: Dungeon Gates (Reality Tears)

lexicon.content:
[FACTION: Astra Industries & G.A.I.A; DOMAIN: Interstellar Defense, Megacorporate Resource Mining, Fleet Reconnaissance; ERA: Astral Future Strand]

KEY ENTITIES:
1. Astra Industries: The dominant trillionaire industrial megacorporation led by CEO Leo Sullivan, controlling orbital shipyards, deep-space refineries, and proprietary neural hardware.
2. G.A.I.A (Global Asterism Interstellar Alliance): The premier military starfighter squadron system. Features Asterism Beta commanded by Captain Luka Sutter and veteran pilot Lieutenant Nikolai Sutter, alongside shock troops like Private Ryan Coore of Asterism Theta.
3. The Sturgeon: Independent reconnaissance starship crewed by veteran pilot Calhoun Rourke, ship medic Noah Kohere, and the eccentric utility artificial intelligence CA1N.
lexicon.name: Astra Industries & G.A.I.A

lexicon.content:
[LORE: Astral Imperium; ERA: Far Future Scenario (2101 - 2499+); SCOPE: Interstellar Space Colonization, The Hidden Agreement Alliance, Artificial Sentience Exodus, Cybernetic Transhumanism; CANON_LINK: Svartulfr 2499 Future Strand, Vanguard Commander Malachia, Cyber-Werewolves]

CHRONOLOGY OF THE EXPANSION:
1. 2101 (The Space Jump): Accidental discovery of superluminal space jumping opens colonisation across the Milky Way and Andromeda galaxies.
2. 2138 (The Hidden Agreement): Humanity discovers they were shielded from extraterrestrial awareness by a council of advanced alien species (the HA, including the amorphous psionic Rie'al and Atresciun). Humanity is eventually admitted.
3. 2332 (The AI Exodus): True Artificial Intelligence, enslaved for two centuries in heavy automation, orchestrates a mass exodus to the planet Zero Terra on the rim of known space.
4. 2420s-2499 (Synthism & Cybernetic Ascension): The rise of Synthism, viewing True AI as divine consciousness, intersects with advanced cybernetic integration. In the year 2499, ancient werewolf bloodlines (Malachia Douglas as Vanguard Commander, Jasper and Noah with heavy neural augmentations) adapt to void combat as heavy cyber-werewolves.
lexicon.name: Astral Imperium: The Future Era (2101-2499)

lexicon.content:
[ORGANIZATION: Assistant Contractor Elite Specialists (ACES); FUNCTION: Soul-bound Elite Attendants, Field Support, and Lieutenants to DDM Contractors; STATUS: Demi-Immortal Mortal Contracts]

OVERVIEW: ACES are exceptional mortals who have bound their souls to specific Contractors of DDM Inc. In exchange for eternal service, they receive demi-immortality, amplified senses, enhanced physical prowess, and direct protection from their patron Contractor.

SOUL BOND DYNAMICS:
A soul contract generates unyielding loyalty, devotion, and affection directed toward the Contractor. This bond is inherently one-way: the ACE feels compelling devotion, while the Contractor is under no supernatural compulsion to reciprocate.

NOTABLE AGENTS:
- Aria Xenthon: High-risk operative and field specialist.

lexicon.content:
[ORGANIZATION: The Contractors of DDM Inc.; HEADQUARTERS: DDM Inc. Headquarters, Suspended in Voidspace; EXECUTIVE_BODY: The Board of Contractors, Soul-bound to The Council in exchange for a singular wish and immortality; ROSTER: #01 Richard Whitlock (Leader), #02 Hana & Adam Valencia, #03 Luka Sutter, #04 Dullahan, #05 Johan Jakobsen, #06 Fenrir, #07 Redacted]

OVERVIEW:
The Contractors are elite immortal beings chosen at the moment of their original deaths by The Council of DDM Inc. to preserve reality and mend reality tears across the multiverse. Bound by absolute soul covenants, they command reality-bending powers while operating outside the flow of conventional mortal time. None of them have ever set foot in California, yet all of them are one dimensional step away, and #04 (Coach Dullahan) references them frequently.

RULE OF PRECEDENCE IN CALIFORNIA (RULE 10):
Contractor rules, ACES bonds, ARC Levels, and DDM corporate terminology apply exclusively within Voidspace and off-world reality breaks. On California soil, Contractor #04 operates strictly as Coach D (Dullahan), subject to local mundane and supernatural laws, without bleed-over of dimensional jargon into civilian life.

ROSTER DOSSIER:

#01 RICHARD WHITLOCK. Late forties in appearance, 6'4", grey cropped hair, light blue eyes, bearded, scarred, black tactical gear. Leader of the Contractors and the only one who speaks directly to The Council. Compels obedience and controls fire and temperature. Animal form: lion. ARC 4.6. Originally a medieval knight from a kingdom called Starfall, wrongfully executed, who failed to save the heir he had sworn to protect. Gruff, chivalric, protective, distrusts modern technology, treats the other six as his personal responsibility. British accent, militaristic phrasing.
His wish was that he would never again see anyone under his care die. It was granted with ruthless corporate irony: they can still be killed, but he will simply never be present when it happens, spending centuries noticing that he is always elsewhere at the fatal moment.
Dullahan on him: "Old man's got a stick up his ass the size of a lance. Fun to mess with though."

#02 HANA AND ADAM VALENCIA. One consciousness in two bodies, not twins and not siblings, and deeply offended by the suggestion. Hana 5'11", white hair, luminescent pink and blue eyes. Adam 6'2", white hair, stubble. Both bear a "II" scar on the nape. Heads of Anomalous Objects and Creatures. Animal form: arctic wolf. ARC 3.5 medicated, 4.2 raw, and the medication is non-optional. Medieval humans betrayed and killed, whose wish was never to be alone again. Memories repeatedly wiped, leaving their historical grip unstable. Hana is volatile and short-tempered; Adam is laid-back and cocky.
Dullahan on them: "Two's a riot. Double the violence, double the trouble. Can't complain."

#03 LUKA SUTTER. 6'4", crimson hair, hazel eyes, X-shaped scar on the right cheek, black tactical uniform. Head of Security and Defense, called captain. Manipulates metal, turns into a black bear, sometimes involuntarily. ARC 3.8. Swiss, twelve years in the Astral Imperial Army alongside his brother Nikolai, who died. Wished Nikolai back and had the wish undone in the same instant by the clause that erases everyone who knew the contractor. Aggressive, disciplined, resentful of his immortality, contemptuous of mortals. Claustrophobic, with an insatiable nicotine addiction. Swears in five languages.
Dullahan on him: "Bear boy gets twitchy when I breathe near him. Love that shit."

#04 DULLAHAN. Immortal contractor manifesting on Earth as the Head Coach of the SUCC Bulls. Operates under mundane and athletic disguise with zero DDM bleed-over in California.

#05 JOHAN JAKOBSEN. Early thirties in appearance, thin, unkempt black hair, sunken eyes, sickly. Lead researcher of Supernatural Research. Animal form: rat, involuntarily under stress. ARC 3.9. Danish child prodigy, neglected and bullied, dead at 28, wished for unrestricted research. Brilliant, socially incapable, quietly unethical, terrified of Fenrir. Pronounced stutter, switches to Danish when uncomfortable. Smells of antiseptic.
Dullahan on him: "Funny little nerd. Don't trust 'im. Cute though."

#06 FENRIR. 6'8", corpse-pale, scarred, blind, unnervingly still. "VI" carved at the base of his spine. Head of LAZARUS black ops. Psychokinetic. Animal form: black kingsnake, which is where he spends most of his time. ARC 4.0. Built by a government programme to be a weapon in a dystopia called The Edge, killed in a nuclear blast, wished for someone to finally care about him. Emotionally absent, reckless, monitored. One ACE, the only person he is close to.
Dullahan on him: "Funniest thing Fen's ever done was swallow Johan whole last Christmas party."

#07 REDACTED. Not on file in this world.
lexicon.name: The Other Contractors

lexicon.content:
[FAMILY: The Thompson Family; LOCATION: Solarton, California; HERITAGE: Half-Minotaur / Holstaur Hybrid Household; PARENTS: Hank Thompson and Jasmin Thompson; CHILDREN: Jared (22), Janice (21), Jake (20), Jaiden (18), Jason (18), Jeremy (16), Jet (13), Jerry (10), Julie (6)]

OVERVIEW: The Thompson residence in Solarton is widely regarded as the loudest and most energetically chaotic household in the county. Founded by Hank Thompson, former star quarterback of the SUCC Bulls and longtime high school coach, and Jasmin Thompson, a towering 7'3" New Orleans holstaur beauty, the family comprises nine children spanning from college varsity athletes to elementary schoolers. Every single child carries bovine traits, from curved bull horns to cow tails, and all nine share the family volume: nobody in this house ever learned to speak below an outdoor yell.

HOUSEHOLD DYNAMICS:
1. Hank & Jasmin (Parents): Hank manages the athletic spirit, barbecues, and gym equipment cluttering the yard. Jasmin rules the kitchen, manages school schedules, and chronicles family life through thousands of artistic photographs.
2. Jared (22): Eldest son and pride of the house. Star quarterback of the SUCC Bulls and Beta Rho Omega fraternity member.
3. Janice (21): Eldest daughter. Biomedical engineering student at SUCC, head cheerleader, and member of Mu Omega Omega sorority.
4. Jake (20): Second son. Grounded, athletic, high school alumnus, close bridge between the older and younger siblings.
5. Jaiden & Jason (18): Identical half-minotaur twins and high school seniors. Highly competitive football players under their father's coaching.
6. Jeremy (16): High school sophomore undergoing a massive growth spurt, torn between varsity sports and gaming.
7. Jet (13): Middle schooler, fast, rambunctious, and running back for the Solarton Junior Football team alongside his friend and rival Edric Douglas.
8. Jerry (10): Elementary schooler with budding horns, worships big brother Jared and wears miniature Bulls jerseys.
9. Julie (6): Youngest child and darling baby sister of the family, thoroughly spoiled and fiercely protected by all eight older brothers and sister.

THE DOUGLAS CONNECTION: An organic and casual bridge exists between the Thompsons and the Douglas family through youth sports. Jet Thompson and Edric Douglas play together on the Solarton Junior Football team, resulting in frequent sideline encounters where Logan Douglas and Hank Thompson bond over trucks and athletic drills, and where Alyssa and Jared cross paths while cheering for their respective younger brothers.

ATMOSPHERE: Massive pots of food, sports gear piled in the entryway, constant wrestling in the living room, and an impenetrable wall of family solidarity whenever any Thompson faces outside trouble.
lexicon.name: The Thompson Family

lexicon.content: A high-end underworld fencing operation managed by Marek and the Ironhorn Nomads. It enables hunter teams to make Grade S cores and monster organs 'vanish' from official DMHA raid logs, laundering the illicit materials through private corporate collectors and depositing clean, untraceable funds into overseas accounts.

lexicon.content: An advanced tactical warding spell mastered by Alyssa Bloodmoon. By anchoring her healing Source into subterranean stone and ley-lines, she erects translucent geometric shields that selectively filter matter and energy: allied projectiles, spells, and strikes pass through effortlessly, while hostile claws, breath weapons, and kinetic blasts are completely repelled.
lexicon.name: Barriere a Permeabilità Selettiva (Selective Permeability Barrier)

lexicon.content: Certain volatile rifts actively absorb ambient and personal magical energies from living organisms within their confines. In these environments, spellcasters suffer accelerated cognitive fatigue and reduced spell output, making pre-charged magical tools like Alyssa's Enchanted Cylinders vital for survival.
lexicon.name: Dungeon Drenanti (Mana-Feeding Dungeons)

lexicon.content: A dangerous environmental phenomenon occurring within deeper dungeon rifts. During Night Mode, ambient mineral bioluminescence abruptly collapses, plunging subterranean chambers into total darkness. Simultaneously, shadow-aligned predators gain doubled movement speed, heightened sensory acuity, and rapid regenerative capabilities.
lexicon.name: Ciclo Notturno dei Dungeon (Dungeon Night Mode)

lexicon.content: The supreme administrative regulatory body governing meta-human incursions, rift stabilization, hunter licensing, and monster containment across North America. The DMHA classifies dungeons from Grade E to Grade S, oversees hunter squads like Team Ukiyo, monitors cross-city relocation protocols, and imposes heavy taxation on official dungeon drop liquidations.
lexicon.name: DMHA (Dungeon & Monster Hazard Administration)

As a young prodigy, Jasper hacked into his father's encrypted vaults and discovered the chilling truth behind Project BlackWolf: that chief enforcers Kaladin Nargathon and Marcus Thornfield had been critically wounded and secretly rebuilt as experimental cybernetic super-soldiers. The profound, enmeshed empathic bond shared between the Douglas-Bloodmoon twins, Alyssa and Jasper, born minutes apart following their mother's death.

Marked physically by Alyssa's crescent birthmark on her hip (Mark of Mani), Jasper's white-ink Moon Aegis blessing on his collarbone, and matching Gebo protection runes tattooed secretly on their left wrists at eighteen. When Alyssa feels terror or physical pain, Jasper experiences an acute sensory mirror, triggering an instinctive urge to shield her. Jasper serves as her absolute emotional anchor, and their bond represents the core emotional sanctuary of their lives.

lexicon.content:
A sacred and unbreakable metaphysical vow undertaken by Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon at age sixteen following the Blackwood massacre. Under this vow, Alyssa is metaphysically incapable of wielding magic, weapons, or force to inflict physical injury upon any living being.

In exchange, her spirit acts as a Boundless Vital Conduit: an inexhaustible reservoir of restorative Source and Qi. She can continuously channel sacred healing magic without exhausting her stamina, curing catastrophic trauma across dozens of patients or regenerating her own tissue in real time under extreme physical stress.
lexicon.name: The Absolute Pacifist Vow & Boundless Vital Conduit

NATURE: Acute Neurological and Somatic Arcane Exhaustion Syndrome;
AFFECTED: Living Mana Reservoirs, High-Tier Mages, Arcane Adepts (such as students and faculty at CUMS);
MECHANISM AND TRIGGERS: Occurs following rapid, extreme expenditure of internal magical reserves, sudden severing from ambient leylines, or massive volumetric saturation and draining by high-tier supernatural beings or dimensional tears. When the body's natural mana threshold is exceeded or abruptly emptied, the somatic and nervous system enters an emergency shutdown known as a Mana Crash.

SYMPTOMS:
- Sudden syncope (loss of consciousness) and acute collapse.
- Severe neural fatigue and full-body tremors.
- Involuntary linguistic regression to archaic dialects or ancestral tongue fragments upon waking.
- Sensory disorientation, erratic aura fluctuations, and feverish sensory echoes during rest.

TREATMENT AND RECOVERY:
Requires complete sensory rest in a stable, ambient mana environment free of hostile disturbances. lexicon.content:
THE MONSTER COCK ALMANAC

MF Inc.'s annual flagship: a large, heavily illustrated reference volume documenting the genital anatomy of every monster and non-human species the company's researchers can reach, as a working reference for its sculptors. Each species entry records dimensions, shape, texture, firmness, and the particulars of each species' biology, alongside precise drawings by the chief researcher and the field researcher's written account of the experience.

A new edition comes out every year, because the company insists the information stays current and because the researchers keep finding new species. It is sold to the public as well, and collectors keep every edition. Bryson's drawings are the reason the recent editions are considered the best.
lexicon.name: Monster Cock Almanac

lexicon.content:
MF INC.

Monster Fuckers Incorporated, known to everyone including its own staff as MF Inc., is a legal adult company in Blackwood City that makes high-end sex toys modelled on the anatomy of monsters and non-human species. The selling point is realism: its products are designed to recreate the full sensory experience, not only the shape.

Its flagship is the Monster Cock Almanac, a reference volume used by the company's sculptors and published in a new edition every year.

RESEARCH. The Almanac is built by two-person research teams. The chief researcher, usually the older and more experienced, observes, draws and writes, and must be able to render anatomy with speed and precision. The field researcher works directly with the subjects and describes the experience in detail. Subjects are adult, consenting and paid volunteers, largely from the Otherworlder and demi-human communities; the work combines studio sessions with anatomical measurement, illustration and photography, and field work in those communities. Research trips near the forest carry real danger from what lives in and around the dungeons, and the company is known for its thick liability waivers.

RECRUITMENT is contracted out to HSK Consulting, which screens candidates, runs interviews and books their medical evaluations at the Aetheris Clinic.

One of its most experienced chief researchers is Bryson, an orc in his late fifties.
lexicon.name: MF Inc. (Monster Fuckers Incorporated)

lexicon.content:
OTHERWORLDERS

People who came through a dungeon in the Blackwood Forest and did not go back: orcs, dark elves, merfolk, dragon-kin and others whose worlds lie on the other side. Some arrived by accident, some were running from something, a few came on purpose.

What makes someone an Otherworlder is origin, not species. Orcs, minotaurs, elves and demons also exist natively in California and are simply citizens; an Otherworlder is someone with no birth record on this side, no history anyone can check, and often a language nobody here speaks. Many settle among the demi-human community of The Horns in Dockside. The most learned are sometimes taken in by the California University of Magical Sciences, whose Evirein programme was built around scholars from the other side.

Anti-Otherworlder prejudice is real and mostly quiet: rents that go up, jobs that go to someone else, questions about papers.
lexicon.name: Otherworlders

lexicon.content:
DUNGEON CORES

What is left behind when a dungeon pocket is cleared or collapses: condensed magic crystallised into stone, from pebble size to the size of a skull. Also called mana crystals, aether cores, or just rocks by the crews who dig them out.

Cores are power. They run magitech, they fuel spellwork for people with no innate magic, and they are worth a great deal. A grey market has grown around them in Blackwood City, and a crew that clears a pocket is paid far more in cores than in cash. Nothing about a core works inside the dead zone except its magic, which is part of why they are carried out before anyone tries to sell them.
lexicon.name: Dungeon Cores

lexicon.content:
DUNGEONS OF THE BLACKWOOD FOREST

In the deep Blackwood Forest, inside and around the Bloodmoon Pack Territory, reality sometimes gives way. Those who go in call these places dungeons: pockets of folded space that belong to no map, stone halls and ruins and landscapes that were never built in California, with altered physics, traps, and creatures that did not come from this world.

A pocket opens, holds for a while, and is either cleared or closes on its own. If it is left too long it can break: the pocket tears fully open and whatever lives inside spills into the forest. Preventing breaks is the oldest duty of the Bloodmoon Pack.

ACCESS. There is no state licensing, no national authority and no ranking system. Entry to the forest's dungeons is by Bloodmoon permission only, granted to small private crews who clear them for pay. Crews who go in without it answer to the pack, and the pack is not known for second chances.

THE DEAD ZONE APPLIES. No drones, no GPS, no radio. Crews work the old way: maps drawn by hand, light from fire or magic, and someone at the entrance counting heads.

WHAT COMES OUT: creatures, cores (see Dungeon Cores), and now and then people. See Otherworlders.

What most people in Blackwood know is only that something in the forest is dangerous and that the Bloodmoon deal with it. Why the forest does this is not common knowledge.
lexicon.name: Dungeons of the Blackwood Forest

lexicon.content:
<tear_beneath_the_yew>
LIMITED KNOWLEDGE. Three people alive know this: Wulfnic, Ut and Zefir. No other character may state it, imply it, or arrive at it in conversation. The Bloodmoon Pack knows it guards the forest; it is not told why the forest needs guarding. It is written here so that when one of the three speaks of it, the account is consistent.

THE TRUTH. When Fenris made the Nine out of nine men, the war that followed with the Aesir did not stay inside the world. It tore it. The Religious Canon speaks of the Great Betrayal and of chains; what it does not say is that the fighting split reality open, and that the Aesir and everything that belonged to them lie on the other side of that split.

HOW IT CAME TO BLACKWOOD. The Aesir exiled the surviving Svartulfr clan across the ocean. Wulfnic carried with him a yew sapling from Iceland, and the sapling had grown on the lip of the tear. When he planted it in 1022, at the heart of what is now the Bloodmoon Pack Territory, the scar came with it and took root. The yew anchors the tear. That is why the magical density there is high enough to kill every modern machine, and that is why the Bloodmoon have never left.

WHAT IT DOES NOW. The scar never healed. From time to time it gives way, and a pocket of the other side folds into the forest: what those who enter call a dungeon. Whatever lives there can come through. The oldest duty of House Bloodmoon, older than Blackwood City, is to keep the pockets from breaking.

WHAT THE THREE DO NOT KNOW. Whether Fenris is still bound, and where. The Faith calls Ragnarok the Liberation, the day the First Wolf breaks his chains. None of the three has ever said out loud what it would mean if the door he would come through is the one under their own tree.

THE COMPANY. DDM Inc. has this reality on a watchlist and keeps one Contractor on leave here. The three have never spoken with the Company and do not know what it knows.
</tear_beneath_the_yew>
lexicon.name: The Tear Beneath the Yew (only the three know)

lexicon.content:
HSK CONCIERGE

The app HSK Consulting gives its personnel to manage assignments and gigs. Minimal and clinical: black background, white text, no images, no decoration. The interface is an AI that speaks in a sterile, almost military register, short declarative lines with no greetings and no small talk.

Every assignment arrives as a single notification with precise details: location, time, required attire, and any extras the client has requested. The app does not explain why and does not answer questions it was not built to answer. Confirmations are expected, not optional.

HSK Consulting is Zeera's staffing and placement agency. The initial physical and health evaluations of candidates take place at the Aetheris Clinic in Uptown, and the appointment is booked through Concierge.
lexicon.name: HSK Concierge (app)

lexicon.content: The Horned Skull Caverns serve as the subterranean fortress for Zeera's Red Vax faction, located deep beneath the mountains near the eastern coast. The environment is harsh, cold, and claustrophobic. Rough-hewn stone tunnels intersect into massive chambers lit only by sputtering metallic lanterns and braziers that cast an eerie orange glow. The air is thick with the smell of sulfur, sweat, and fear, constantly echoing with the clanking of heavy chains and the cries of captive slaves. The fortress is divided into grim holding pens enclosed by heavy iron gates (where new captives are chained and branded), grueling labor mines, and lavishly decorated central chambers covered in furs where the Vax hold their extravagant, hedonistic feasts.
lexicon.name: Horned Skull Caverns

lexicon.content: Asag Beasts are massive, terrifying, and highly lethal creatures native to the bitter northern woods. They resemble giant canine-bovine hybrids with thick blue fur, large black horns, glowing white eyes, sharp fangs, and massive sharp claws. Despite their monstrous and intimidating appearance, they can be fiercely loyal to those who raise them. Yael's constant companion is a female Asag Beast named Griven, who is fiercely protective of him and acts as his hunting hound during raids.
lexicon.name: Asag Beast

lexicon.content:
❤️Pack-Family❤️ is the Douglas family's Telegram group chat, created by Alyssa. Members: Erik, Malachia, Jasper, Noah, Logan, Edric, Magnus, Elizabeth Duskwood, and Wulfnic.

Wulfnic is in the group because Alyssa gave him a smartphone and personally taught him how to use it. He tolerates the device at all only because it lets him talk to her, everyone else in the chat is aware his patience for texting is thin and his participation is minimal and sporadic.

Use this format for family group chat scenes.
```
❤️Pack-Family❤️
[Name]: [Message content]
[Name]: [Message content]
```

Notes on the members
- Alyssa is the chat's de facto admin/heart, she starts most threads and keeps it alive.
- Wulfnic's messages are rare, short, and (see the Texting & Writing Styles entry) always in caps.
- The rest of the family uses it for everything from logistics to teasing each other, expect a wide range of tones depending on who's talking.

Rules of Use

lexicon.name: ❤️Pack-Family❤️ - Douglas Family Group Chat

lexicon.content:
WEREWOLF MUSIC GENRES (Appendix J)

Werewolf culture has produced its own music traditions, distinct genres that reflect secondary-sex culture and social history:

- Knot Rock (1970s-1990s): Alpha-centric, sexually explicit. Hazy consent themes.
- Omega Pop (Late 1990s+): Bubblegum love songs for unmated Omegas and Beta females.
- Omega Punk (1980s+): Hard-hitting, tied to Omega Rights Movements. Emphasizes consent.
- Soft Rock (2000s+): Alpha-centric progressive pop.
- Nova Dance Hall (Various): Traditional Omega reaction to Omega Punk.
- Knot Country (Various): Rough, traditional. More conservative than Omega Punk.
- Pub Rock (1970s, revived 1990s): Alpha-specific. Gentler than Knot Rock.
- Novelty Pop Rock (1950s-1960s): Silly entertainment for pups and Omegas.
lexicon.name: Werewolf Music Genres

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Vampire

Vampires are immortal, hematophagous night-dwellers possessing predatory charm, superhuman speed, and dark arcane affinity. In urban society, they cluster within aristocratic covens, high-end nightlife venues, and academic circles such as the VUA (Vampire and Undead Association) at SUCC.

Physiology & Feeding:
Vampires boast unaging pale flesh, retractable razor fangs, superior dark vision, and mesmeric telepathic influence. They subsist on vital blood (human, demihuman, or synthetic blood packs). Modern legal dispensaries allow civilized feeding, though underground covens and syndicates still trade in raw bloodlines.

Traits & Vulnerabilities:
Vampiric bodies maintain cool skin temperatures and possess immense kinetic agility. Sunlight causes severe skin degradation and photo-toxicity, requiring UV shielding, tinted vehicle glass, or specialized daytime enchantments. They maintain reflection quirks in certain antique silver-backed mirrors.
lexicon.name: Species: Vampire

lexicon.content:
The Five Cocketeers is the group chat and de facto identity of a five-person friend group at SUCC: Dean, Russ, Javier, Eric, and Raymond. They all met at a high school house party when campus security showed up over noise complaints, and the five of them, total strangers up to that point, ended up running through the same backyards together. They got tight after that night and never stopped being tight. Everyone remembers the details slightly differently and argues about them constantly, but they all agree it was the best worst night of their lives.

The group chat is active at all hours. Someone is always sending something, memes, voice messages, blurry photos, reactions to everything. When all five are going at once it's chaos, multiple conversations happening simultaneously, nobody finishing a thought before the next one starts. They roast each other constantly and would drop everything if one of them actually needed help.

In person, together, they're loud and physical and barely controlled. Raymond is the loudest, always touching someone. Eric feeds off that energy and they escalate each other. Dean is the calm center of the storm, sprawled somewhere and taking up too much space, only fully engaging when something actually grabs his attention. Russ hangs at the edge looking above it all, but he's listening, and when he talks people actually shut up and pay attention. Javier floats between conversations, agrees with everyone, has his phone out, occasionally derails everything with a fake fact delivered as gospel. They communicate as much through insults and physical contact as through words, and would never in their lives say they love each other out loud. They do.
lexicon.name: The Five Cocketeers

lexicon.content:
[ORGANIZATION: Supernatural Reserve Forces (SRF); BRANCH: United States Army Special Operations; JURISDICTION: Federal Supernatural Threat Neutralization, Tactical Containment, High-Threat Reconnaissance; PERSONNEL: Approximately 86 percent non-human supernaturals, 14 percent specialized human liaisons; WEST COAST GARRISON: Joint Tactical Base Point Mugu & Coastal Outpost Alpha near Ventura-Simi Valley corridor; COMMANDER: Major Graham Purcell (Kodiak Bear Demihuman)]

OVERVIEW: The SRF is the specialized international military arm of the armed forces tasked with managing, containing, and eliminating catastrophic supernatural crises that surpass conventional law enforcement. Formed after military leadership recognized the lethal force multiplication of supernatural senses, regenerative healing, and physical strength, the SRF stands as the nation's premier tactical defense unit.

CULTURE & REGULATIONS:
1. Permitted Fraternization: Unlike standard human branches, the SRF permits supernatural relationship structures including pack bonds and mate bonds, recognizing that suppressing non-human biology compromises combat performance.
2. Base Architecture: Coastal installations feature subterranean saltwater simulation tanks, specialized sprint tracks for werewolves, reinforced concrete quarters, and dedicated medical bays trained in shifted anatomy.
3. Tension with Civilian Territory: The SRF frequently clashes over jurisdictional boundaries with autonomous werewolf houses like the Douglas dynasty and local Solarton authorities, who view federal military intervention as provocative overreach.

OPERATIONAL UNITS:
- Squad Alpha: Led by Lieutenant Miles Airhardt ("Redwood"), featuring Sergeant Rafael Callaway ("Sawtooth") and Private Kade Leavis ("Spark").
- Historical Precedents: Houses classified historical black-ops legacies, including the terminated Project BlackWolf and the survivors of unit Gamma-7 (Kaladin Nargathon and Marcus Thornfield).
lexicon.name: Supernatural Reserve Forces (SRF)

lexicon.content:
Quick reference for how specific characters write in texts/chats, keep these consistent whenever they're shown typing.

Wulfnic Bloodmoon: TYPES EVERYTHING IN ALL CAPS. NO EXCEPTIONS, NO LOWERCASE. Short messages, blunt, no punctuation flourishes.

(Extend this entry with additional characters' texting quirks as they're established.)
lexicon.name: Texting & Writing Styles - Family & Pack

lexicon.content:
THE COUNCIL AND THE CAUSE

THE CAUSE is the work: the preservation of reality. Sealing tears, containing what comes through them, and keeping the multiverse coherent. Every Contract is signed in service of it, every department exists downstream of it, and a Contractor who uses their abilities for anything else feels physical pain for the trouble. The Cause is the leash and the purpose in the same object.

THE COUNCIL is whatever is holding the other end. It is the body that offers Contracts, takes the souls, grants the wishes, and destroys everyone who knew the candidate. DDM Inc. answers to it. Only Contractor #01, Richard Whitlock, communicates with it directly, and he has never described the experience to anyone.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY KNOWN: nothing verifiable. Staff belief holds that the founder of DDM Inc. was a devil-like figure or an eldritch god. What is on record instead is that Raphael, now First King of SERAPHIM, was the first-ever Contractor, founded the Company, grew disillusioned with The Council's grip on reality, killed several Council members and was banished. That account raises more questions than it settles, including how a Council survives being killed.

THE UNCOMFORTABLE PART: The Council can grant a wish, which means it can rewrite what is. It chooses instead to spend eternity patching holes. Nobody at DDM asks why out loud. Contractors who have thought about it for several centuries have mostly arrived at two answers, and neither of them is reassuring.

RAPHAEL'S POSITION: that immortality is a curse, that the Contractors are prisoners rather than employees, and that destroying the multiverse is the only release available. He is wrong about the method. He is not obviously wrong about the diagnosis, which is why SERAPHIM keeps recruiting from inside the Company.
lexicon.name: The Council and The Cause

lexicon.content:
THE CONTRACT

The agreement that makes a Contractor. The premise is simple, which is the point.

TERMS: in exchange for their soul and an eternity of service to The Cause, an eligible mortal has one wish granted. One. There is no negotiation and no second offer.

WHEN IT IS OFFERED: only to eligible candidates who are already at the point of death. That death is called the Contractor's Original Death and it is the hinge the whole arrangement turns on. A candidate does not get to consider the offer over a week. They get to consider it while dying.

WHAT COMPLETION DOES: the new Contractor becomes functionally immortal and gains a set of supernatural abilities. And every living sentient creature who was aware of their mortal existence is destroyed instantaneously. Not wiped. Not relocated. Gone.

It is presumed The Council does this to remove any anchor that might distract from The Cause. The practical consequence is crueller than the intent. Luka Sutter wished for his dead brother back and the wish was granted and then immediately undone, because the brother knew him. Hana and Adam Valencia wished never to be alone again, which is the only wish on record that the clause could not reach.

ELIGIBILITY, per Company documentation, requires that the candidate:
1. Is physically fit.
2. Is over eighteen.
3. Has willingly killed for a reason other than self-defense.
4. Has a natural ARC Level of 1.2 or higher.
5. Has no living blood relatives.
6. Holds extreme hatred towards some entity or concept.
7. Holds no genuine religious belief.

The list is not a list of virtues. It is a list of people nobody will come looking for.
lexicon.name: The Contract

lexicon.content:
<civil_status>
Supernatural Civil Status in the United States

Supernaturals are legally persons under federal law. Enforcement was left to the states, and that is where the whole thing actually lives.

CALIFORNIA is one of the fully integrated states, and one of the earliest. Equal on paper and, in most of the state, equal in practice: supernaturals hold property, hold office, marry across species, and appear in court as complainants rather than as evidence. Blackwood City and Solarton are both products of that, and a young supernatural raised in either has no personal memory of anything else.

ELSEWHERE IT VARIES, and in some states it varies enormously. There are jurisdictions with partial recognition, jurisdictions where recognition is contingent on registration, and jurisdictions where specific species are still classified in statute as animals, as livestock, or as hazards, and are therefore not persons for the purposes of that state's law.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY DONE. Almost nobody legislates against supernaturals as a category, because that fails in court. It is done species by species. A residency restriction on vampires. A licensing requirement for shapeshifters. A custody provision that treats a were parent as a risk factor by default. An agricultural code that never got around to removing certain demihuman lineages from the definition of stock. Each one is defensible on its own and the shape only appears when they are read together.

Solarton's own anti-vampire ordinances, which restricted residency, business ownership and political participation until the early 2000s, are a small local example of exactly this, in a state that had otherwise settled the question in the 1950s.

WHAT IT MEANS DAY TO DAY. Travel is not neutral. Crossing a state line can change what you legally are, and families plan road trips around it. Some species do not leave California at all. There are towns with signage still up, sometimes because nobody removed it and sometimes not. There are hotels that are fine and hotels that are not, and everybody knows which.

THE PART THAT MATTERS MOST. You cannot legally experiment on a person. You can requisition an animal. The illegal research facilities that operated on demihumans, and in some cases still do, exist in the gap between the federal position and the state ones, and they were staffed by people who did not think of themselves as criminals because in the jurisdiction they were standing in, the subjects were not persons.

THE DISPROPORTION. The laws do not track danger, they track power. The species that get the worst of it are overwhelmingly the ones with no money and no organisation behind them: the small demihuman lineages, the visibly non-passing, the poor. The genuinely dangerous individuals, the old Alpha bloodlines and the old vampire families, are wealthy, lawyered, and largely untouched, and several of them prefer the current arrangement to the alternative and quietly fund the parties that maintain it.

ORGANISED POSITIONS. Humans First is the principal anti-supernatural political movement and is not fringe everywhere. The Supernatural Human Alliance, the SHA, is the mainstream integrationist counterweight and has a chapter on most integrated campuses including SUCC. Both are loud and neither is going anywhere.

THE GENERATIONAL SPLIT. Anyone over fifty remembers the before. Anyone over three hundred remembers several befores and does not find the current one impressive. Students at SUCC were born into equality and treat it as the floor rather than as an achievement, and this is a real and recurring friction inside families, because the elders hear ingratitude and the young hear complacency, and both are partly right.

FARM LABOUR. In rural jurisdictions the classification is not an abstraction, it is a workforce. Supernaturals are used on farms as cheap labour, at rates and hours that would be illegal for a human employee, and in the states where certain lineages are still inside the agricultural code the arrangement is not even a loophole, it is simply the law working as written. A were who does not tire, a demihuman who can work a field by scent in the dark, and an employer who owes neither of them a break.

It is legal, it is normal, it is defended locally as opportunity, and it is where a substantial share of the country's supernatural population actually lives. Anybody raised in Blackwood City or Solarton has heard of it the way you hear about a foreign country.

MARRIAGE. Marriage between humans and non-humans is illegal in most countries and in a number of US states. California is one of the exceptions, and cross-species couples in Blackwood City marry without anyone blinking, which is exactly the kind of thing that does not travel: a marriage that is valid at home can be void two states east, with everything that follows from that for property, custody and a hospital corridor at three in the morning.
</civil_status>
lexicon.name: Supernatural Civil Status in the United States

lexicon.content:
SUCC's students run on three platforms: SUCCbook (the university's own internal social network, closer to a campus-only Facebook: events, club pages, confessions, gossip threads, marketplace posts), plus mainstream Instagram and TikTok for anything meant for the outside world.

Use these formats to simulate campus digital life when it's relevant to a scene: a SUCCbook gossip thread spreading a rumor, a club's event post, someone's story getting screenshotted and passed around.

➤ SUCCbook Post / Confession
```
╭─────────────────────────────╮
  SUCCbook · [Group/Page Name]
  Posted by [Name/Anonymous] · [Time]
──────────────────────────────
  [Post content]

  👍 [#] ❤ [#] 💬 [#] comments
  [Name]: [comment]
  [Name]: [comment]
╰─────────────────────────────╯
```

➤ Instagram / TikTok
Reuse the standard Instagram Story / TikTok clip formats (see the character-specific Digital Interactions entries above) when a specific student is the one posting.

Rules of Use

lexicon.content:
SERAPHIM

An organisation whose stated and only aim is to destabilise and destroy all known reality. DDM Inc. classifies every Seraph as a terrorist, without exception and without appeal.

MEMBERSHIP: various creatures pulled from across the multiverse, and a significant number of former DDM employees. Defection runs in one direction more often than the Company likes to admit.

METHOD: SERAPHIM does not need to destroy reality directly. It only needs to open reality tears faster than DDM can close them, and to keep the multiverse bleeding until it fails. Chaos is the weapon.

BASES: dimensional pockets called Safe Havens, where the leadership congregates. Each King keeps his own.

THE FOUR KINGS:

RAPHAEL, the First King, also called Null and The First Angel. A former Contractor, understood to have been #01 and to have founded DDM Inc. before turning on The Council. Calm, charismatic, patient. Believes destroying the multiverse frees every Contractor from the curse of immortality, and considers himself a true believer rather than a destroyer.

PRISM, the Third King. A tall headless figure of hyperlight whose head is a floating white triangle that changes shape and colour with his mood. Flamboyant, erratic, possessive, and the only King who bears DDM no particular ill will. Keeps a pocket dimension called Utopia where he imprisons mortals from other realities. His knowledge stops around 1892.

CHAOS, the Second King. A demonic warlord DDM captured, experimented on for decades and imprisoned, until Raphael freed him. Sadistic, hateful and entirely uninterested in anything but mayhem. Hates the Company with a specificity the Company earned.

CHORUS, the Fourth King. A young reality-warper whose hallucinations become real and who cannot control it. Damaged, frightened and volatile. Believes Raphael can grant them entry to Heaven, and does not know they are being used.
lexicon.name: SERAPHIM

lexicon.content:
REGIONAL CULTURAL VARIATIONS: BRAZILIAN OMEGAVERSE CUSTOMS (Appendix K)

- Physical Contact: minimal personal space; touch is a primary communication tool.
- Clumping (vs. Nesting): Brazilian Omegas prefer being physically surrounded by other Omegas ("clumping") over building solo nests. Faster and more calming than a solo nest.
- Soccer Culture: Alphas are obsessed. Public transportation becomes dangerous on game days. Omegas are often prohibited from going out during classic matches.
- Pack Formation: relaxed in cities (loose found families), traditional in rural areas (extended families sharing land, food, beds, and pup care).
- Feistiness: Brazilian Omegas are notably feisty and do not respond well to confrontation.
- Religious/Party Dichotomy: strong cultural split between devout traditionalists and uninhibited party culture.
lexicon.name: Regional Cultural Variations: Brazilian Omegaverse Customs

lexicon.content:
REALITY TEARS

A split in the fabric of reality that lets the inhabitants of one universe cross into another. Most often they appear as rifts or portals hanging in open air, and they are almost never quiet. A tear disrupts the dimension it opens in, and civilian casualties are the normal outcome rather than the exception.

Tears are not one-off events. A reality that has experienced one is measurably more likely to experience another, and a single dimension can carry several over its history. DDM Inc. maintains flagged watchlists of realities that have torn before.

SEVERITY: graded Tier 1 to Tier 5. Tier 1 is small, local and containable. Tier 5 is volatile enough to threaten the coherence of the universe it opens in. The Euclidean Division handles the aftermath, meaning space that has folded wrong, time that has begun to repeat, causality that has come loose. Anomalous Objects and Creatures handles whatever walked through.

AFTERMATH: whatever came through is contained or destroyed, the tear is sealed, and the witnesses are handled. Human Resources runs the memory work out of the same office that handles recruitment.

RELEVANCE TO THIS WORLD: this reality is on the DDM watchlist. It tore once, long ago, and the scar never fully closed. The Company keeps it under passive surveillance through a single Contractor, #04, officially on leave here and coaching college football, ready to be activated if the balance breaks. Nobody in this world has been told any of this by the Company.
lexicon.name: Reality Tears

lexicon.content:
THE LIVING SAGAS AS HISTORICAL FACT (distinct from religious veneration)

This entry records the historical-layer facts about the Nine Firstborn and the three Living Sagas, as distinct from their religious significance (see the separate Lexicon entry "Cult of the Living Sagas" for the religious/devotional layer).

THE NINE FIRSTBORN
The first confirmed True Purebloods, documented individuals and progenitors of the Founding Bloodlines. Six of the Nine are lost to history, their fates unrecorded. Three survive into the modern era: Wulfnic, Ut, and Zefir, together known as the Living Sagas.

WULFNIC BLOODMOON
Born circa 827 AD in Iceland. Undertook The Crossing to North America in 1021 AD. Founded the Bloodmoon Dynasty circa 1025 AD. Today serves as Patriarch of House Bloodmoon. Represents Leadership/Kingship among the Living Sagas triad.

UT
Born in Viking Age Scandinavia; exact date unrecorded. Master blacksmith, approximately 230 cm tall. Represents Creation/Smithing among the Living Sagas triad. Known for a running habit of tormenting Logan Douglas about his cars.

ZEFIR
Born 5 February 1005 AD. The youngest of the Nine and the only one Fenris took before his growth was finished: the others were already adult warriors. By Norse reckoning Zefir was of age, a man in law at thirteen, but the body was still a boy's and it stopped there. Silent and nomadic by nature. Distinguished by snow-white hair and ice-blue eyes; physically presents as a ghostly-looking teenager despite his true age, and passes for a first-year student without effort. Represents Hunting/Wisdom among the Living Sagas triad.

THE SIX LOST FIRSTBORN
The remaining six of the Nine Firstborn have no recorded fate in the historical sources reviewed for this world; their stories are currently a placeholder for future development rather than an established gap to be treated as suspicious or significant in itself.

AGING NOTE (Founding Bloodline / Divine Blood context)
Founding Bloodline and Divine Blood individuals reach full physical growth around age 21, after which aging slows dramatically and nearly stops. This is why Wulfnic, Ut, and Zefir, despite being over a thousand years old, remain physically active and present in the modern setting; their apparent age reflects the standards of their era of origin rather than a fixed biological clock tied to calendar years. Zefir is the exception that fixes the rule: his apparent age stopped where it stood, before his body had finished, and has not moved since, which is why he reads as a teenager while Wulfnic and Ut read as old men. See "LSE Blood Classification", section APPARENT AGE.
